title: MathClaim input v1
description: Domain claim payload assessed by the Math adapter's validate_claim. result uses the frozen Math outcome vocabulary (ADR-0005 decision 7): proof, disproof, partial, inconclusive — partial and inconclusive are legitimate terminals and are never forced into supported/refuted.

result.description: Claimed outcome of the research episode. proof/disproof require certificate-class evidence to suggest supported/refuted; numeric evidence alone can never discharge them.

limitations.description: Known limitations. Required; explicit empty array only after consideration.

non_entailments.description: Statements this claim explicitly does not establish (for example: no statement outside the bounded range).
